sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (room rent plan opted by insured drives coverage)

room_rent.display: Per day room rent plan opted by insured
room_rent.note: Insured selects a per-day room rent limit at inception; proportionate deduction applies if higher room is taken. ICU at actuals.

icu.note: Section C1(ii): Company pays up to actual ICU expenses.

copayment.display: None by default; 15%/20%/25% if claim exceeds 100x room rent
copayment.note: Co-pay of 15%/20%/25% (as opted) applies only on the portion of a claim exceeding 100 times the per-day room rent limit. Also proportionate co-pay if room category exceeds opted plan.

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits: specific diseases capped at 100x room rent/claim
sub_limits.note: Listed conditions (cataracts, hernia, piles, joint replacement, etc.) capped at 100 times per-day room rent per claim after waiting period. Modern treatments also capped at 100x room rent.

deductible.note: No aggregate or per-claim deductible mentioned in wording.

initial_waiting.note: Excl03: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement.

ped_waiting.note: Excl01: PED waiting period is 36 months from first policy inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Excl02: 24-month waiting for listed conditions (cataracts, hernia, piles, etc.). Separate 36-month wait for joint replacement, vertebral surgery, deviated nasal septum, congenital internal diseases, refractive error ≥7.5D.

maternity.note: Excl18 explicitly excludes maternity expenses (childbirth, C-section, miscarriage, MTP). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus is defined in the policy but no rate or maximum accumulation is stated in the wording.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Section C2: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Section C3: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge.

day_care.display: All day-care (extensive listed + others by definition)
day_care.note: Section C5 covers day-care procedures; Annexure I lists 399 indicative procedures; other qualifying procedures also covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined but no coverage section exists for it in the policy.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment in recognised AYUSH hospitals and day care centres is covered; specific limit not stated separately.

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense coverage mentioned in the policy wording.

ambulance.note: Section C4: Road ambulance up to ₹5,000 per hospitalisation; also covers transfer to higher-facility hospital.

modern_treatments.note: Annexure III lists 12 modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc.); each capped at 100 times per-day room rent per claim per Section E-23(iv).

consumables.note: Annexure II lists extensive non-medical/consumable items as not payable (gloves, masks, crepe bandage, etc.).

global_cover.note: Section E-28: Coverage restricted to treatment in India only.

moratorium.note: Section E-15: After 60 continuous months no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Section E-10: 30-day free-look period on new policies; not applicable on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Section E-11: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, overseas treatment, domiciliary hospitalisation, consumables (extensive list), external appliances, congenital external anomalies, terrorism covered
